items.what: Starting Dec 2, 2026, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories unless an Actions event policy allows them. Brownouts run Nov 9 and Nov 16, 16:00-18:00 UTC.
items.source_name: GitHub changelog: pull_request_target blocked by default December 2 (Nov 2, 2026)
items.test: Before Nov 9, use Insights to find workflow runs the rule would block, including AI agent or PR-review bots on pull_request_target. Allow the ones you need in an Actions event policy, or move them off that trigger.

deadlines.label: pull_request_target blocked by default in public repos

items.what: gemini-2.5-pro is deprecated. Effective Dec 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-pro automatically route to gemini-3.8-flash and are billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates, with breaking API changes.
items.test: Search your code for gemini-2.5-pro, switch it to gemini-3.8-flash before Dec 1, and test function calling, thought_signature handling, thinking_level (replaces thinking_budget) and any sampling parameters or prefilled model turns.

deadlines.label: gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash requests auto-route and bill at new model rates

items.what: gemini-2.5-flash is deprecated. Effective Dec 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-flash automatically route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite and are billed at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates, with breaking API changes.
items.test: Search your code for gemini-2.5-flash, switch it to gemini-3.5-flash-lite before Dec 1, and rerun your evals: the same breaking changes apply (thought_signature validation, thinking_level, removed sampling parameters and prefill).
